text: Revenue went up by 4000 BRL between 2018-02 and 2018-03. The largest contribution came from SC (2400 BRL). The second largest contribution came from ES (1600 BRL). Revenue is defined as: Total payments received for delivered orders The figure comes from raw.orders, raw.order_payments; the logged cleaning steps are parse_dates, drop_exact_duplicates.
